current_answer: At about 22:32 UTC on October 17, 2026, Kalshi’s October Chance headings showed 87% “Fed maintains rate” and 14% “Hike 25bps”; Polymarket’s separate named rows showed 87% “No change” and 14% “25 bps increase.” Both favored a hold for the October 27–28 FOMC meeting. Compared with the October 15 19:05 UTC page check, the hold reading rose 15 percentage points on Kalshi and 14 on Polymarket. BLS reported September import prices up 1.1% and export prices up 2.2% on October 16, but neither venue page supplies a reliable quote time or an explanation for the change.
